lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like array of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least four horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, particularly visible in the mid-flank section, forming localized anchor points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Distinct longitudinal ridge running parallel to the dorsal midline, exhibiting a high-contrast transition from a light upper edge to a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, low-luminance elongated shape is visible near the ventral-posterior margin of the pectoral fin, consistent with a commensal organism.
